WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.currency
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(
            r.amount_minor
            * CASE
                WHEN eo.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
                WHEN eo.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
                WHEN eo.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
              END
        ) AS refund_usd
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN eligible_orders eo
      ON eo.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        eo.amount_minor
        * CASE
            WHEN eo.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN eo.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN eo.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
          END
        - COALESCE(rt.refund_usd, 0)
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders eo
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt
  ON rt.order_id = eo.order_id;

      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
),
refunds_per_order AS (
    SELECT

SELECT
    SUM(
        eo.amount_minor
        * CASE eo.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
          END
        - COALESCE(rpo.refund_amount_minor, 0)
        * CASE eo.currency

            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
          END
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders eo
LEFT JOIN refunds_per_order rpo

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.currency,
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END AS usd_factor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
),
refunds_per_order AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds r
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        e.amount_minor * e.usd_factor
        - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0) * e.usd_factor
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders e
LEFT JOIN refunds_per_order r
  ON r.order_id = e.order_id;

WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id

    JOIN customers c

      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN valid_orders vo
  ON vo.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL

      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
electronics_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        qo.currency,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor) AS gross_revenue_minor
    FROM qualifying_orders AS qo
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = qo.order_id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'electronics'
    GROUP BY qo.currency
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        gross_revenue_minor
        * CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
          END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM electronics_revenue;

SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency
        WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
        WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
        WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND EXISTS (

    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        0
    ) AS share_placed_more_than_one
FROM january_customers;
